mapper.select: SELECT id AS session_id, analysis_attempt AS attempt, song_id, score_version, start_note_idx, end_note_idx, bpm, bpm_unit, recording_url FROM practice_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND analysis_attempt > 0 AND recording_url IS NOT NULL AND analysis_started_at >= #{startedAfter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluations (session_id, total_score, pitch_score, timing_score, duration_score, model_version) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{totalScore}, #{pitchScore}, #{timingScore}, #{durationScore}, #{modelVersion})

INSERT INTO note_results (evaluation_id, note_idx, expected_pitch_id, detected_pitch_id, pitch_error_cent, onset_error_ms, duration_error_ms, verdict) VALUES
(#{evaluationId}, #{n.noteIdx}, #{n.expectedPitchId}, NULL, #{n.pitchErrorCent}, #{n.onsetErrorMs}, #{n.durationErrorMs}, #{n.verdict})
